note: Echo Drift Surge season for GraveGain MMO endgame (games lane, v2-native). A limited-time cross-game season: drift surges sweep all three games, warbands chase surge-front records, top warbands earn the driftskipper title. ASCII only.

modifiers.effect: Hourly surge window: +25% XP in all games for 10 minutes
World-boss fronts deal back 10% less; warband records tracked per front
Weekend warband bonus doubled (drift-runners sigil: +20% instead of +10%)

rewards.detail: Seasonal loot cache per cleared surge front
Top-10 warbands each week earn the driftskipper title
